# `firearms.mixin.client` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

This mod's client mixin surface (`docs/spec/04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-001): three small mixins, all gated on one widened check, that let a scoped weapon reuse the vanilla spyglass mechanic exactly as `docs/spec/decisions/DEC-009-scope-mechanic.md` decided — firearms.mixin.client.PlayerScopingMixin widens the shared gate itself, firearms.mixin.client.FieldOfViewMixin reads a per-optic FOV factor in place of the spyglass's hardcoded 0.1f, and firearms.mixin.client.ScopeOverlayMixin swaps the overlay texture — plus one unrelated fourth, firearms.mixin.client.AttackControlMixin (`FA-24`, `docs/spec/decisions/DEC-019-controls.md`), cancelling vanilla's own attack-swing handling while a firearm is held, now that the attack control fires rather than swings.

### `class AttackControlMixin` — `src/main/java/firearms/mixin/client/AttackControlMixin.java`
Cancels vanilla's own attack-control handling while a firearms:weapon is held (`docs/spec/decisions/DEC-019-controls.md`, `docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` WEAPON-REQ-018's "the attack control shall not swing, break blocks or melee-hit"): firing is now this mod's own firearms.client.fire.FireInputHandler, sending firearms.fire.ServerboundFirePayload off the same Options.keyAttack state, so vanilla's own swing/break/melee handling for that same key press must not also run for a firearm — a bullet does the hitting, never the swing.

### `class FieldOfViewMixin` — `src/main/java/firearms/mixin/client/FieldOfViewMixin.java`
Reads the attached optic's own zoom factor for the FOV modifier, in place of vanilla's fresh hardcoded 0.1f literal inside AbstractClientPlayer.getFieldOfViewModifier(boolean, float) (`COMBAT-REQ-007`).

### `class PlayerScopingMixin` — `src/main/java/firearms/mixin/client/PlayerScopingMixin.java`
Widens Player.isScoping() — in vanilla an exact Items.SPYGLASS identity check, isUsingItem() && getUseItem().is(Items.SPYGLASS), never keyed on the use-animation (confirmed by `javap -p -c` against the 26.2 merged-deobf jar; research `smithing-and-item-model-layers-26-2.md` §C.1) — to also return true while a player is using a firearms:weapon stack with a magnifying optic attached (`COMBAT-REQ-006`).

### `class ScopeOverlayMixin` — `src/main/java/firearms/mixin/client/ScopeOverlayMixin.java`
Swaps the texture Hud.extractSpyglassOverlay(GuiGraphicsExtractor, float) draws off vanilla's own hardcoded SPYGLASS_SCOPE_LOCATION static field for the held weapon's optic overlay (`COMBAT-REQ-008`).
